title: Mayfeld
subtitle: Independent
description: Migs Mayfeld served as an Imperial sharpshooter during the Empire. He'd seen service across the galaxy, but during Operation: Cinder, he found himself under the command of Valin Hess when his entire division was wiped out. He turned to a life of crime and on both sides of the Mandalorian Din Djarin's ire, first betraying him, and then forced to help him rescue the youngling Grogu.
